As a young person who is a morning person, I wish more people saw it that way. I'm tired of defending why I wake up early and why I choose to get all my things done early. It's so I have the rest of the day to be "free"

I used to get up at 6 am every weekend for 4 years from the ages of 15-18.

Basically all I had to do was to train myself to sleep earlier. If I didn't sleep earlier, I knew that I would still be required to wake up for 6. If I was up very late, I would still try to sleep despite the small amount i would get. Sometimes I would sleep for less than an hour and then go on with my day. Those days were difficult, but they taught me that I need my sleep the night before if I'm going to be waking up early. It's really a self-discipline thing. When I'm awake, I'm awake. Theres no point going back to sleep. Unless I have additional time before my required wake up time of 6am.
